history.note: reverse_engineer: adopt UHP (unifiedharnessprotocol.org, open versioned HTTP contract w/ OpenAPI 3.1 + conformance suite) as the canonical harness-router contract; implement natively in AllternitOS Layer-3 harness router + ao execution substrate. Upstream as-is is Docker-only (hard veto) so thin_adapter/fork of the container is out; fork_reskin conflicts with ao Rust direction (rq-20260908-028, decided 2026-09-08). Fills baseline gap: agent-native API surface (Responses-compatible turns, streaming, cancel, idempotency, session checkpoints). NOT ported: provider/key management — Allternit gateway + A:// tier policy already own routing. Complements ao (orchestration brain + interactive steering stays), Fabric (session pickup stays), Brain (knowledge plane stays).

reverse_engineer -> fork_reskin (human redirect 2026-09-09): fork HarnessRouter CE and strip the Docker packaging. Docker is only the appliance layer (bundling + per-session-user isolation); gateway+runner are plain Python loopback servers, UI is Next.js. New scope folded INLINE into the ao v3 plan as P6 (UHP execution layer, Docker-free fork supervised by the ao binary) + P7 (harness auto-install/onboarding from HR first-run installer). Not in the Rust binary (Python cannot embed); ao supervises gateway+runner as loopback child processes. Provider/key routing stays in the Allternit gateway — HR connection-policy machinery not ported. See Products/AgentOrchestratorRuntime.md §2.6, P6, P7.

fork_reskin -> Rust native implementation (human, 2026-09-09): "since it is python we must implement it in our rust language; the things that dont port over [drop]". HR CE is demoted from fork base to REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION: UHP spec + OpenAPI schemas + conformance suite + per-backend pytest suite are the parity oracle run against our Rust server. Vendored for reference/tests only, no shipped Python. P6 re-scoped: Rust UHP gateway+runner inside the ao binary (new workspace crate; home at P6 gate). Ports: Responses surface, sessions/turns/streaming/cancel/idempotency, SQLite backing, backend-driver LOGIC (subprocess CLIs), installer scripts. Drops: Next.js console, per-session-user sandbox, push-to-cloud/marketplace, Python/Node relay internals where a backend needs a re-implemented relay (Hermes license-undeclared -> gated anyway). Phasing: P6a core + the backends ao already drives headless; P6b remaining drivers against HR pytest behavior.

UI + assets + credential-model refinements (human 2026-09-09): (1) HR console UX patterns PORT as design reference — system-harness catalog cards + per-harness live telemetry (turn stream, commands, files, tokens, cost) feed ao TUI face (P2) + visibility panel (P5); console code itself still dropped. (2) ui/public/logos/* (11 brain marks) harvested to "Allternit Assets/Brand/Third-Party/harness-brains/" with provenance README — these are the brains actual icons for choose-a-brain surfaces. (3) Credential model corrected: NOT "no second key store" — two legitimate homes per human: native authed CLI runtimes (user logins/subs) + Allternit cloud credentials on the platform plan (platform.allternit.com) via the Allternit gateway; UHP layer owns no keys, only HR per-backend broker machinery dropped.

Gate decisions applied to spec: (1) external dev API keys out of scope — ship with Allternit Cloud subscription product, internal-Orgo stays first-party; (2) local kind (Tart on Joe's Mac) committed to Phase 1; (3) workspaces = org + group label in Phase 2; (4) model-driving stays on ACU canonical gateway. Spec section 'Gate decisions' is binding for the executing agent.
